summary: A box that counts how many clicks land outside it using the clickOutside action.
use: Closing popovers, dropdowns and inline editors when the user clicks elsewhere on the page.
spec: `use:clickOutside={() => count++}` imported from `@codeatlasdev/ui/actions` on a `div` with `class="box"`
`let count = $state(0)` is incremented by the callback
Box text: Click inside this area, then click outside.
